device: Apple M3 Ultra, 60 GPU cores, 96 GB unified, 819 GB/s published peak
gpu_time_authority: completed MTLCommandBuffer GPUStartTime/GPUEndTime after wait; never a CPU-wait proxy
claim: Efficiency is the dominant term, but the 0.135% figure and the 0.6462-pack 124.85 fs ceiling are both category errors. The honest batch=1 decode control on this box is 320-411 GB/s unique-bytes-once, not 819 and not the 536-637 reuse band. Against that control, every existing Q80 pack is hundreds of fs/weight even at a perfect load-only kernel. Sub-100 fs is unreachable unless ACTIVE decode BPW (attention + lm_head included) drops below 0.256-0.329.

honest_control_gbps.what_to_use: token-shape 320-363 GB/s is the honest control for a 1-2 GB unique-once decode. 536-637 is a cache-reuse roofline. 819 was not measured.

byte_budget_per_token.note: complete_physical_bpw is a STORAGE average over 79.67 B weights, 97% of which are unused experts. Decode moves top-10+shared experts plus ALL nonexpert active weights.
